name: Hanover County, VA
findings: Hanover County has 355 nonprofit organizations. 164 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 136 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Hanover County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 19 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 9 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do social and fraternal organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
